title: Frequently Asked Questions
content: Common questions and answers about visiting Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha.

questions.a: Morning: 6:00 AM - 12:30 PM, Evening: 5:00 PM - 8:30 PM
Traditional Indian attire is recommended. Saree for women, Kurta-Pajama or Dhoti for men.
Photography is not allowed inside the sanctum. External photography is permitted.
Yes, free parking is available at the main entrance and east entrance.
Annadanam is the free meal program offered to devotees. Timings: 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM daily.
Sevas can be booked online through our website or at the temple counter.
Yes, wheelchair access with ramps is available at the main entrance.

questions.q: What is the best time to visit?
questions.a: Weekdays are less crowded. Morning hours (6-8 AM) offer a peaceful darshan.
